requirements.statement: For each DHT22 sample, the firmware shall verify the sensor checksum; on checksum failure it shall retry once within the same 2000 ms cycle and, if still invalid, shall not update the published temperature/humidity for that cycle.
criteria: When a DHT22 frame has an invalid checksum, the sampling logic performs exactly one retry before completing the sample cycle. (expected: Two checksum validation attempts occur: the initial attempt followed by exactly one retry within the same sampling cycle.)

When both the initial DHT22 frame and its single retry have invalid checksums, the published temperature and humidity remain equal to the last valid values for that cycle. (expected: The published temperature and humidity after the failed cycle are unchanged from the previously published values.)

When both DHT22 checksum validation attempts fail, the sampling logic records an error event for the failed sample. (expected: At least one error event identifying the failed DHT22 sample or checksum failure is recorded during that cycle.)

When both DHT22 checksum validation attempts fail, the DHT22 failure counter increases by one and the sampling cycle returns to its periodic loop without publishing new sensor values. (expected: The failure counter is initial value plus one, the published values are unchanged, and the sampling cycle completes so the periodic loop can proceed.)

requirements.statement: The firmware shall maintain a configurable alert threshold for temperature.
criteria: After the runtime configuration method sets the temperature threshold to a value different from its previous value, the stored threshold equals the new value and temperature evaluation uses that value for alert decisions. (expected: The configured threshold equals V_new, and the evaluation result matches comparison with V_new rather than V_old.)

requirements.statement: The firmware shall maintain a configurable alert threshold for humidity.
criteria: After the runtime configuration method sets the humidity threshold to a value different from its previous value, the stored threshold equals the new value and humidity evaluation uses that value for alert decisions. (expected: The configured threshold equals V_new, and the evaluation result matches comparison with V_new rather than V_old.)

requirements.statement: The firmware shall maintain a configurable alert threshold for G-force.
criteria: After the runtime configuration method sets the G-force threshold to a different value in g, the stored threshold equals the new value and G-force evaluation uses that value for alert decisions. (expected: The configured threshold equals V_new g, and the evaluation result matches comparison with V_new rather than V_old.)

requirements.statement: Updates to configurable alert thresholds shall be stored atomically in non‑volatile memory and shall persist across power cycles; after reset the most recently committed values shall be in effect.
criteria: When the non-volatile storage write reports a persistence failure, the configuration logic retains the last known-good threshold values and emits an error log. (expected: All active thresholds remain equal to the last known-good values, and the log contains an error entry identifying the persistence failure.)
